name: Duplex-GS
definition: A dual-hierarchy framework for real-time order-independent Gaussian splatting that combines alpha-blending with reformulated Weighted-Sum Rendering (WSR) to eliminate popping and transparency artifacts while reducing sorting overhead.
summary: Duplex-GS is a dual-hierarchy Gaussian Splatting framework that eliminates transparency artifacts and reduces sorting overhead by combining alpha-blending with cell-level transmittance decay.
